GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Got its head up and raced fiercely in the early and middle stages and near the 700m had to be checked off heels. Shortly after straightening near the 400m had to be steadied when awkwardly placed near heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 12 lengths. well back turn. hooked very Wide in Straight . made some ground # start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and was shifted behind runners in the early stages of the event. Passing the 1400m commenced to over race until passing the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from a low draw. Settled Down 7th on rail 6 Lengths @ 950m. Same Straightening Up . Just Held Ground # No Run On

Shade slow away. Beaten for early speed & raced @ rear 3 Wide (7L from lead). Stayed same until improving Four Wide from 550m & pushed along Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & gave ground Four Wide in last 200m. Vetted - 3/5 lame near hind. # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam found the mare to be lame (3/5) in the near hind leg. Trainer was advised a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat back 5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, kept on one pace # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1100m was carried wider, the mare then commenced to race keenly and got its head up when being restrained to obtain cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on strong # sound
Jumped Ok eased to last 8l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home ok but never threatening # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted behind runners from a wide barrier in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn looking for run. held up early in Straight . went for run but checked 200 metres. # total forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over-raced in the middle stages. Was held up approaching and rounding the home turn and until the 200m when its rider attempted to initially take a narrow run between runners but was checked by its rider when that run further tightened. Tightened for some distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 6-7l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 4l off, battled on well but never a threat # leader dominated
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1000m had to be restrained after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 4 lengths. under pressure turn 3 lengths. ran on well in Straight . not much room late # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Was held up from near the 200m until the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 12 lengths. well back turn sticking to fence. ran on strongly along fence. # start no help
Slow Out 1 length drove through to settle Mid Field 4 lengths. got split turn. ran on strongly with winner. just missed # start costly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 800m had to be steadied off the heels of rnr which was steadied when crowded.
